item: Living sources: held lanes merge when the import group commits (R729 L1 amendment)
summary: While the import queue holds a corpus on its working copy, the backup's encrypted lane members are kept beside it and merged when the group is saved (after the items are recorded done, so a kill mid-merge never relabels a live corpus); each held merge counts an attempt; a group that is not saved leaves the lanes owed and a re-import merges them.
